question: Across an 8-seed cohort, does densifying the SO(3) pool put the closest-to-truth member of the T_A=25 survival cloud into the s059i robust regime?
hypothesis: At higher pool density the cohort lands in the robust regime (closest-survive <=7.5deg), making the s059j omega-grid architecture cohort-viable.
narrative_md: Cohort validator: at N=400k Sobol all 8 seeds (6,10,14,23,28,44,84,89) land in the robust regime (median closest-survive 1.37-2.40deg); even at 100k 7/8 are robust -- seed 28 was the outlier, not representative. s059j is decisively GO. New caveat: |C_a| varies 20x (1473 to 29940 at 400k), so the (q_a x omega) joint-search cost is seed-dependent. Measures closest-geodesic-to-truth_q_a -- oracle-leak, cohort N=8.
